parts.title: The Master's Door
parts.text: Giulia had waited years to become an **apprentice** in the busiest workshop in Florence. On her first morning, the master, an **eccentric** sculptor who wore two different shoes and chatted with his statues, handed her a broom. Pablo, who had joined a year earlier, promised to be her **mentor** and show her the daily routine. In the corner, Noor, a visiting **scholar** from Cairo, spent hours translating old books about geometry.

parts.title: Grinding and Carving
parts.text: Her first job was to grind colored stones into **pigment**, the fine powder that painters mixed into their paints. Next Pablo handed her a **chisel** and a scrap of marble to practice on. The master's training was **rigorous**; he made her redo a single line twenty times until it was perfect. Giulia was **zealous**, arriving before sunrise and staying until the candles burned low, because she wanted to prove she belonged.

parts.title: The Big Order
parts.text: One afternoon a wealthy **patron**, a banker who paid artists to decorate his family's chapel, swept in. He placed a **commission** for a marble fountain, due in one year. The master asked Giulia to **devise** a way to move the heavy stone through the narrow streets. She sketched a **blueprint** of ropes, rollers and wooden ramps, and Noor checked her measurements using the math in her ancient books. The master studied the drawing for a long time, then nodded.

parts.title: A Fountain Rises
parts.text: Months later, the fountain stood in the chapel courtyard, water sparkling over the smooth white stone. Giulia learned that talent mattered, but patience, practice and good teachers mattered just as much. She smiled at the crowd, already dreaming of her next project.

definitions.meaning1: A person who learns a skill or trade by working for a skilled expert. Example: The baker's apprentice learned to knead dough before sunrise.
definitions.meaning2: To work as a learner under an expert. Example: She decided to apprentice with a local blacksmith.
